full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Anacardic Acid Technology Value Proposition: Increases cotton fibre yield and quality. Summary Application: India tops the world in having largest area under cotton cultivation. However, the yield of cotton in India is destitute being 500 Kg/ha compared to the country like Brazil which has cotton yield about 2000 Kg/ha. Thus, innovative technologies are needed to improve yield in India which will be a direct benefit to the farmer. A formulation has been developed which improves cotton yield. Multi-location trials in different cotton growing states showed 10-15% increase in yield of popular cotton hybrids. This formulation also brings earliness in boll bursting. It works by augmenting actions of phyto-hormones involved in cotton boll development. Advantages: Technology promises at least 10% increase in cotton yield that will contribute to Rs. 2000-5000/hectare increase in the income of a farmer. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Automatic Biomass Briquetting Plant Value Proposition: Nowadays, biomass briquettes have been regarded as a great substitute for traditional coal. In many countries, biomass briquettes are used as cooking fuels or to heat industrial boilers to produce electricity from steam. Going green is one of the ways that we will be able to save our environment for future generations. The use of briquettes is one of the ways that we can help manage and conserve the environment. Therefore, we should embrace the continuous use of this energy source to our advantage and set up our biomass briquetting plant to make a profit now! The increase in air pollution is a prevalent global challenge. One of the key reasons behind this sustained increase in air pollution is the burning of fossil fuels such as petroleum products and coal. In developing countries, the use of fossil fuels is common because of its wide availability. Using briquettes as fuel alternatives can substantially cut down fossil fuel consumption, thereby improving the current environmental conditions. Summary Application: Cost-effective solution for the disposal /use of agricultural and agro-industrial waste It can be used for the production of briquettes for domestic as well as industrial purposes for operating furnaces, boilers It can be used in dhabas and restaurants for tandoor. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Benzo[De]Isoquinoline-1,3-Dione Based Compound and Use thereof Value Proposition: A rapid, wash-free, fluorescence-based diagnostic probe that enables detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis within ~15 minutes, while simultaneously targeting a validated mycobacterial enzyme (DprE1). The technology offers high specificity, minimal background signal, low operational complexity, and potential integration into point-of-care diagnostic platforms, particularly suited for resource-limited settings. Summary Application: The technology is based on a naphthalimide (benzodeisoquinoline-1,3-dione) solvatochromic fluorophore conjugate that selectively binds to Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Upon interaction with the bacterial cell wall enzyme DprE1, the probe exhibits a distinct fluorescence turn-on response, enabling rapid and wash-free detection of live mycobacteria. In addition to diagnostic capability, the probe demonstrates intrinsic antitubercular activity, establishing a dual diagnostic–therapeutic (theranostic) function. Advantages: Rapid detection of M. tuberculosis (~15 minutes) Wash-free detection with negligible background fluorescence High specificity towards Actinobacteria, reducing false positives Dual diagnostic and therapeutic (theranostic) functionality via DprE1 targeting Chemically stable, room-temperature storage compatible pH-independent fluorescence response across physiological range Cost-effective, scalable one-pot synthetic route Suitable for translation into point-of-care diagnostic formats Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: BFBR:A High-Rate Anaerobic Reactor for Complex Wastewater Treatment Value Proposition: The Buoyant Filter Bioreactor (BFBR) has designed for treatment of high strength complex wastewater. BFBR converts wastewater containing a high ratio of suspended COD to total COD Summary Application: The Buoyant Filter Bioreactor (BFBR) has designed for treatment of high strength complex wastewater. BFBR converts wastewater containing a high ratio of suspended COD to total COD. Suspended organic materials that contribute to anaerobically degradable COD include starches and complex carbohydrates, proteins, fats and oils. Conventional high-rate anaerobic reactors are not efficient at retaining suspended COD. Unlike in conventional high-rate UASB, the BFBR has a high efficiency retention mechanism with forced cleaning system to retain both suspended solids and biomass, and thus achieve high efficiency for wastewaters with suspended COD. The high velocity backflow is created by periodic release of gas accumulated in the reactor (US Pat. 6592751), thereby avoiding extra pumping systems and power consumption. BFBR system has been customised and installed in different rice mill and ice-cream factories as per the effluent capacity Advantages: 1. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Bio-Mechatronic Orthotic Device with Virtual Intelligence for Children with Cerebral Palsy Value Proposition: Cerebral Palsy (CP) affects muscle tone and occurs in approximately 2.1 out of 1000 live child-births. Without timely rehabilitation, it can lead to permanent deformities and locomotor disability. In India, CP children use standard Knee Ankle Foot Orthosis (KAFO) and walkers, but these devices do not significantly improve Gross Motor Function (GMF). To address this, a Bio-Mechatronic Orthotic Device with Virtual Intelligence (BioMOD) has been developed to enhance walking ability and GMF in children with CP. Summary Application: The device enables precise and regulated movement of knee and ankle joints, aiding in effective motor rehabilitation. BioMOD consists of two parts: a mass-producible component (sensor, actuator, control unit, power source) and a customized exoskeleton (standard KAFO) and software. Advantages: End-users include physiotherapists, parents of affected children, and rehabilitation centers. The technology can be transferred to orthotic devices and specialty footwear manufacturers. This development addresses the urgent need for sustainable alternatives to plastic, which has been a major contributor to pollution, contaminating oceans, clogging waterways, and harming wildlife. The biodegradable products, including plates, bowls, spoons, and cups, are not only environmentally friendly but also safe for hot and cold foods and microwave-friendly. Their adoption could significantly reduce plastic waste in high-traffic areas like railway stations, airports, and food courts Moreover, these products support a circular economy by converting into nutrient-rich animal feed after use Addressing both plastic pollution and agricultural waste management, this innovation is well-positioned to make a substantial impact in promoting sustainable development and resource efficiency, offering a practical solution to reduce our environmental footprint. Summary Application: This innovative technology produces biodegradable tableware and cutlery from agricultural waste materials such as rice straw, coconut shells, and sugarcane bagasse, providing a sustainable alternative to single-use plastics. The products, including plates, bowls, spoons, and cups, are eco-friendly, safe for hot and cold foods, microwave-compatible, and can decompose into nutrient-rich animal feed after use. By addressing both plastic pollution and agricultural waste management, this development promotes a circular economy, reduces environmental impact, and supports sustainability in high-traffic areas like railway stations, airports, and food courts. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Biofumigation Technology for Protection of Stored Pulses (1 Tonne Capacity) From Insect Pests Value Proposition: Biofumigation technology provides a sustainable, eco-friendly solution for protecting stored pulses from insect pests by using natural bioactive compounds derived from plants like mustard, neem, and garlic. It eliminates the need for synthetic pesticides and chemical fumigants, ensuring residue-free, safe storage that meets organic and food safety standards. This approach preserves grain quality, extends shelf life, and prevents pest resistance. Cost-effective and scalable, it benefits farmers, traders, and storage operators by reducing post-harvest losses and enhancing market value. Biofumigation aligns with consumer demand for clean, green technologies in food systems, supporting both environmental sustainability and economic efficiency. Summary Application: Biofumigation technology is applied in storage facilities to protect pulses from insect pests using naturally occurring volatile compounds released from biofumigant plants like mustard, neem, or garlic. These compounds act as natural insect repellents or toxins, disrupting pest activity without leaving harmful residues. Ideal for use in warehouses, silos, and farm-level storage, this method is particularly valuable in organic and sustainable agriculture. It enhances the safety, quality, and shelf life of stored pulses while complying with eco-friendly and food-safe standards. Advantages: Biofumigation offers an eco-friendly, chemical-free method to protect stored pulses from insect pests. Utilizing natural plant-based compounds, it minimizes toxic residues and preserves grain quality. It’s safe for human health, reduces environmental impact, and prevents pest resistance. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Bottom Pulsated Aero-Hydro Two Product JIG Value Proposition: JIGS represent one of the earliest types of machinery employed in mineral and coal processing. Their adaptation to process coal established jigs as the most popular and efficient method of coal cleaning for over a century until the arrival of dense medium process. Increased demand for more and more cost-efficient methods of beneficiation lead to a review of the jigging process. Application of new concepts and the use of new technology of manufacture and controls resulted in new forms of jigs. Summary Application: Large capacity Batac jigs is available in the market and these are usually procured and installed at the washeries. Unfortunately, no elaborate studies were carried out on treatment of high ash Indian coals using the batac jigs and hence the performance evaluation while treating Indian coals is lacking. To study the performance evaluation a smaller capacity jig is required where the parameters may be monitored and controlled. It is difficult to get a low capacity test rig and unfortunately it is not available in the market. CSIR –CIMFR, Dhanbad India is having experience of washing Indian coals and huge data available on the characteristics of different coals. This will help in designing a low capacity bottom air pulsated jig (test rig) which may fulfill the requirements of R&D purposes. Advantages: Easy to operate, effective separation of shale/stones, Less Maintenance cost and indigenously developed Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Brick Masonry Triplet Shear Tester Value Proposition: Masonry triplet specimens are widely used to determine the parameters associated with the shear strength of brick masonry (i.e., shear bond strength and bed-joint friction coefficient). This test requires two different loads to be applied on the specimen. Firstly, a pre-compression that is vertical and constant throughout the test is required and then a shear force that is horizontal and monotonically increasing. In the literature, either two servo-controlled actuators have been used (or) one reaction-based jig and a hydraulic jack for this purpose. The developed brick masonry triplet shear tester involves a simpler means of pre-compression through gravity and horizontal load through a screw mechanism or hydraulic jack. The shear tester is a simpler set-up compared to two servo-controlled actuators method, whilst reliable in nullifying the effects of dilation compared to the reaction-based jig method. Summary Application: Determination of parameters associated with the shear strength of brick masonry Advantages: Simple yet reliable working mechanism. Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Building Energy Management System (BEMS) Value Proposition: IoT enabled BEMS is to monitor and control the entire building in terms of security, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) status, and energy consumption for effective energy management. Many physical parameters constrained to the building such as temperature, humidity, occupancy & door/window status, etc. are monitored and necessary control operations are implemented. The system integrated intelligent logic to control the individual loads such as ON/OFF as per the standards/requirements. The developed system has three components viz. environmental node to monitor the environmental parameters, energy node to monitor the electrical parameters, and control node to control the individual loads through Wi-Fi. The developed system is plug-and-play and retrofitting modules. Summary Application: Intelligent building energy management in commercial/industrial buildings such as offices, campuses, Hospitals, hostels, hotel Industries, etc. Advantages: Measure and display the total energy consumption of the building. Monitor the events/status of the occupancy, doors, and windows of the rooms in a building. Reduced the energy consumption and hence bill. Detect smoke and send timely alerts for necessary actions. Control the appliances such as air conditioners, lights, and fans in the building. Monitors the room temperature to take necessary actions on controlling the air conditioners for maintaining the human comfort level in the building. Online monitoring through a web-enabled user interface and user-friendly dashboard. Scheduled report generation and timely alerts to the user. Users can add/remove loads to the BEMS system through GUI. Commercialization Status: Licensed awaiting commercialisation Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Calla Lily: agrotechnology Value Proposition: Calla lilies are popular floriculture plants which are in demand for their exotic blooms, glossy foliage and used both as cut flowers as well as flowering potted plants. Calla lilies can be used as cut-flowers, potted plants and also as landscape plants for bog gardens. Cala lilies are suitable for open cultivation under low and mid hills. Summary Application: Market potential Trade of Calla lilies in the Indian market is currently estimated at Rs.150 crores with an annual growth of 20%. Major producers of Calla lily are New Zealand, United States, Kenya and Taiwan. Advantages: Calla lily varieties developed by CSIR-IHBT Two cultivars of Calla lilies, representing species of commercial importance Zantedeschia elliottiana (Him Sumukh) and Z. aethiopica (Him Shweta) were developed through hybridization and selection approach. Him sumukh has yellow trumpet shaped blooms, while Him Shweta is evergreen with white flowers. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Cardanol Polyol Modified Poly Urethane Dispersions (PUDs) Value Proposition: Cardanol Polyol Modified Polyurethane Dispersions (PUDs) represent an innovative and sustainable technology in the field of aqueous polyurethane dispersions. By incorporating cardanol polyol, the dispersions show superior properties as compared to petrochemical polyols, including enhanced light fastness, adhesion, and hydrophobicity. This eco-friendly alternative not only adds value to agricultural resources but also provides improved mechanical and corrosion resistance properties, making it suitable for a wide range of applications, from coatings to medical devices. The use of cardanol, derived from cashew nut shell liquid, demonstrates a significant step towards utilizing renewable resources in polymer chemistry. Furthermore, these PUDs showcase the potential for developing high-performance materials that meet both industrial requirements and environmental sustainability goals, paving the way for future advancements in green chemistry and materials science. Summary Application: Cardanol Polyol Modified Polyurethane Dispersions (PUDs) offer a sustainable innovation in aqueous polyurethane dispersions by utilizing cardanol, derived from renewable cashew nut shell liquid. These PUDs outperform petrochemical polyols, providing superior light fastness, adhesion, hydrophobicity, mechanical strength, and corrosion resistance. Their eco-friendly nature and versatility make them ideal for applications in coatings, medical devices, and more. By adding value to agricultural by-products, this technology promotes green chemistry and supports environmental sustainability while delivering high-performance materials for industrial use. Advantages: • Sustainable Solution: Cardanol Polyol Modified PUDs offer a green alternative to conventional polyurethane products, promoting environmental sustainability. • Superior Properties: These dispersions exhibit enhanced light fastness, adhesion, and hydrophobicity compared to traditional polyol-based polyurethanes. • Versatile Applications: The technology is applicable in various fields, including leather coatings, hygiene coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers, and medical devices. • Improved Performance: Cardanol Polyol Modified PUDs provide better formulation flexibility, stronger adhesion, water resistance, and enhanced hydrolytic stability. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: CDRI 1703F003 for PCOS Management Value Proposition: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is one of the unmet medical need of women all over the world not only for fertility, but also for primary health management due to androgen excess and irregular reproductive cycle associated complications. The prevalence of polycystic ovarian syndrome is generally thought to be between 3% and 10%. PCOS has been reported a metabolic and endocrine disorder, affecting the overall health of a female. Endocrine and metabolic disorder can give rise to ovarian pathophysiology, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), which is disturbance of ovarian follicular development Summary Application: As a part of our nutraceutical/dietary supplement development program, we found that 50 and 150 mg/kg body weight doses of the bioactive compound N017-0036 and its enriched fraction 1703-F003 respectively improved the ovarian health by increasing the preovulatory follicles and ovulation potential (corpus luteum) at the same time decreasing the cystic follicles. The pure compound N017-0036 alone improves the ovulation independently in the PCOS animal model. The proposed nutraceutical product (1703-F003) development has enormous clinical application and market potential. Advantages: 1703-F003 is enriched with non-steroidal natural compound (N-017-0036); therefore, has enormous clinical benefits in young women and married women, suffering from PCOS. The bioactive fraction 1703-F003 was developed from single herb. The plant material is cultivated; hence, easily available commercially at a cheaper price all over India. The raw material used to prepare bioactive fraction (1703-F003) is renewable; thus, no environmental or biodiversity issue arises. The plant material and its extracts have been approved to develop a nutraceutical product by FSSAI (Schedule IV and VI); therefore, it would be easy to develop and commercialize the product. The process for nutraceutical/dietary supplement development from bioactive fraction (1703-F003) is very simple and economically viable The bioactive fraction (1703-F003) is water soluble to make various dosage forms such as tablet or capsule. An inexpensive formulation of 1703-F003 has already been prepared and efficacy confirmed. The quality and efficacy of bioactive fraction (1703-F003) can be monitored by bioactive marker (N017-0036). The bioactive fraction 1703-F003 found to be safe up to 5 grams in acute toxicity studies in rats. Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: CIM-Larvishield Novel Polymeric Bead Formulation for Mosquito Larvicidal Action Value Proposition: Most of the available mosquito larvicidal products contain hazardous chemicals such as; chlorinated hydrocarbons, organic phosphates (organophosphates), carbamates, pyrethroids, and permethrin. However, persistent usage of these products produce resistance and have a harmful impact on humans and the environment. Thus, there is a need to develop the product using plants that are biodegradable, eco-friendly, and non-toxic to humans. Using essential oils derived from plants can be a potential alternative to control mosquitoes and might solve the problems associated with products that contain hazardous chemicals. As per the available literature, plant-based leads are a safe and effective option for managing mosquitoes, and their acceptance among consumers is high compared to synthetic products.In the present formulation, we have used a combination of biodegradable polymers to develop polymeric beads. The entrapment of essential oil in polymeric beads can be a promising approach for extending the stability and therapeutic efficacy of oil, and a prolonged delivery would provide an adequate larvicidal action. The present lead is a safe food-grade oil with plant origin and is effective at the conc. of 32ppm at the site of application. Summary Application: The used fennel oil is a food-grade oil. Fennel is a traditional and well-known aromatic plant with a long history of medicinal use and is among the most widespread medicinal plants worldwide. Fennel oil has shown effectiveness against mosquito larvae and can be considered as an alternative for mosquito larvicidal activity. Encapsulation of fennel oil using polymeric beads has proven to be a good approach to reduce the fennel oil volatility resulting in enhanced stability, efficacy, and prolonged delivery of fennel oil. This formulation is effective in killing the mosquito larvae. Advantages: Oil-loaded polymeric beads are designed with biodegradable polymers and natural bio-active The formulation is safe, effective, consistent, and pharmaceutically elegant Easy to formulate, use, store, and non-toxic to non-targeted organisms Commercialization Status: Already Commercialised Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Colorized Galvanizing Coated Steel Products and its Process Value Proposition: The colorized hot dip galvanizing coating with different shades has been obtained with ease and stable commercial operations in single dip process. Presently, there is no single coating industries in India which is producing commercial colorized hot dip galvanizing coating in single step using both type of batch as well as continuous hot dip technique for various steel components. Summary Application: Steel sheet coupons are coated with the colorized hot dip galvanizing coatings in different color shades by batch type hot dip method. The present invention relates to steel industrial sectors related to batch hot dip galvanizing coating lines for large components like towers, pillars, pipes, rods, roof sheets, bridge angles, gates etc. as well as small components like screws, nut-bolts, fasteners, spanners, solar panel liners, steel handles, cap-covers, sheep components etc.as well as continuous hot dip galvanizing coating line of cold rolled steel sheets. Salient Technical Features: Zinc base alloy coating with the colorized surface appearance of different types of shades having better chromaticity. The colorized galvanizing coating have Enhanced stability of the obtained less Iridescence colour in normal air cooling Minimum variation of bath composition particularly least content of Mn and Ti. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Compact Electric tractor (CSIR PRIMA ET11) Value Proposition: The developed compact Electric Tractor is 100% Pure electric, mainly to cater to small and marginal farmers of India. This tractor has a base power of 11 HP, which falls in the category of N1 tractor. It has the following features: 1) The e-tractor has been designed and manufactured with indigenous components and technologies. 2) To cater to the demand of agriculture field applications, the electric tractor has been designed so that its dynamics, weight distribution, transmission engagements, and lever and pedal position have been well considered during development. 3) The developed technology is that it is Women-friendly. To achieve this, special attention in the ergonomics, replacement of mechanical levers with electronic switches, to name the few. 4) The farmers can charge the tractor using a conventional home charging socket in 7 to 8 hours and operate the tractor for more than 4 hours in the field. Otherwise, the tractor can run more than 6 hours in case of normal Haulage operation. 5) The tractor is designed with a robust and efficient transmission system to achieve the desired efficiency. 6) The tractor is equipped with best-in-class hydraulic with a lifting capacity of 500 kg. It implies that a tractor can lift implements required not only for field operation but also for hauling operations. The electric tractor can also tow a 1.8-ton capacity trolley with a max speed of 25 kmph. 7) The Electric traction is built with a Lithium-ion battery with a Prismatic cell configuration. It has a deep discharging capability suitable for farming applications and, simultaneously, has a life of more than 3000 cycles. Moreover, the controller and the instrument cluster have been modified to suit agricultural needs. 8) The electric tractor is equipped with the V2L port; when it is not in operation, its battery power can be utilized for other secondary applications like pumping, etc. The proposed solution will contribute significantly to country’s economic growth by providing an alternative to conventional diesel engine operated systems. This Technology will help MSME to get venture in the e- tractor segment. Summary Application: As the working conditions in India are quite challenging compared to other developed countries, hence there is a need for development based on the Indian condition. CSIR CMERI has developed an Indegnous Compact Electric tractor (CSIR PRIMA ET11) for small marginal farmers. Industry Partners: 1.M/s K.N.Biosciences India Pvt.Ltd., Bachupally Road, Industrial Area, Ameenpur, Miyapur, Hyderabad-502325, Telangana 2.M/s Sunrise Transmissions, Infinity, Ayodhya Chowk, Rajkot-360006, Gujarat Advantages: Robust and Semi Synchro-type mechanical drivetrain. Modular Mainframe for maintainability and Serviceability. Improved and efficient hydraulic System. Improvised and optimized drivetrain for smooth transition of gears. Optimized weight-to-power ratio. Women-Friendly Ergonomics. Intelligently controlled prime movers. Customized instrument cluster Suited for e-tractor application. Vehicle Health Monitoring Features. Electric Vehicle to Load feature (V2L concept). Indigenous and Cost Effective. Commercialization Status: Licensed awaiting commercialisation Tech. The system includes on-site dewatering processes to separate liquid and solid of the sludge, along with wastewater treatment capabilities. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Continuous Vibro Fluidized Bed Roaster using Flue Gas Value Proposition: Roasters are generally of batch-type. There are a few fluidized bed roasters which are electrically heated. However because of the volume of air required for fluidization the process is too slow to reach and maintain roasting temperatures and uneconomical. CSIR-CFTRI’s design adapts Vibro-fluidization method wherein vibration assists in fluidization (and hence uniformity), needs less air and LPG makes it almost instantaneous in reaching roasting temperatures. Summary Application: CSIR-CFTRI’s design adapts Vibro-fluidization method wherein vibration assists in fluidization (and hence uniformity), needs less air and LPG makes it almost instantaneous in reaching roasting temperatures. Advantages: Air mixed with products of combustion from LPG to get 300-350°C hot air. Retention time on the deck controlled by varying frequency and amplitude of vibration. Roasting, resting and cooling-all in one machine. Suitable for cereals, oil seeds, pulses. Capacity: ≈ 150kg/h. Commercialization Status: Already Commercialised Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Development of High Carbon High Chromium White Cast Iron with Improved Wear Resistance for Grinding Media Applications Value Proposition: The grinding media so developed is used for grinding clinker for cement production. The developed GM has a better wear rate than the existing products in the market. Summary Application: Process/ Alloy has been developed for the production of high chrome high carbon cast iron with improved wear resistance. Heat Treatment has been optimized to get better wear resistance. Oil temperature and viscosity of the oil have been optimized to have a faster quenching rate and also to achieve distortion-free grinding media. The stress-relieving practices are optimized to relieve the residual stresses generated in the quenching. The process is economical and energy intrinsic. The heat generated in the quenching process is utilized for the stress-relieving process. No external or additional furnace is used for the stress-relieving process. The tray used as a container of grinding media for the purpose of feeding in heat treatment furnace has been designed to achieve a homogenized temperature of optimized temperature on each grinding media in the heat treatment furnace. The hardness of 66-67.8 HRC has been achieved. A specific wear rate of 5.4 mm3/N-m is achieved in comparison to that of 6.7 mm3/N-m of original balls. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: DNA Barcode Technology for Plant Authentication Value Proposition: Incremental interest of pharmaceutical and herbal industries at domestic & international level have been contributing significantly in the economic growth of global medicinal plants sector. The major problem associated with plant based raw botanical drug/ phytomedicines is their correct identification using appropriate technology and detection of adulteration. To cater the industry demands, we developed a reproducible DNA based technology for rapid authentication of plant species. Summary Application: India being among the 17 mega biodiversity countries of the world is a custodian of more 18,000 angiosperms with approximately 7000 are of medicinal and pharmaceutical important. In India, annual medicinal plant based raw material trade is 1,28,000 tons with a value of Rs. 4200 crores annually and contributes 8% in total global market export. Indian pharmaceutical market is expected to grow up to USD 55 billion by 2020. Current DNA based plant identification system can be utilized to cater to increasing demand of pharmaceutical sector for authentication of raw plant materials and also to facilitate regulation in legal system of supply chain. Advantages: The salient feature of this technology is that it utilizes conserved nature of maternally inherited genomic regions/gene sequences for rapid authentication of plants at species level Tech. In the daylight conditions, these phosphors do not emit any noticeable light. Under UV lights of different wavelengths, the phosphors show different emission colours. The developed security inks using these phosphors produced various writings on different surfaces, including currency notes and QR codes. The above technique can prevent fraud and duplication of logos, currency notes and documents. Summary Application: CSIR-NIIST has developed dual-colour emitting inorganic phosphors for advanced security and anti-counterfeiting applications. These phosphors remain invisible under daylight but emit distinct colours under UV light of varying wavelengths. Utilizing these phosphors, security inks can be produced to create secure writings and markings on surfaces such as currency notes, QR codes, and official documents. This innovative technology is ideal for preventing fraud and duplication, ensuring enhanced protection of logos, currency notes, and sensitive documents. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Dual Slab Floor Isolation Technology for Seismic Damage Mitigation Value Proposition: The importance of protection of sensitive instruments, critical equipment, vibration sensitive industrial facilities, to maintain them in operational condition during and after natural disasters like earthquake has been recognized in literature. This proposed technology for new buildings helps in damage mitigation of critical infrastructure facilities located in a floor by bringing down the response of the slab. In this technology the roof slab is cast in two parts. Top circular part can slide on the bottom part at the curved interacting surface which has been enabled through provision of mini rollers. In order to prevent the movement of the curved slab beyond the allowable limits during earthquake, rubber restrainers are fabricated to the required stiffness and are provided in the middle span of the beams supporting the slab. Preliminary experiments have been carried out at laboratory level to demonstrate the efficacy of the scheme on 3-storey composite frame (steel frame with RC slab) 1.5mx1.5m square in plan. Summary Application: Can be implemented in critical facilities viz., new hospital rooms with equipment like MRI scanner, laboratories with sensitive instruments, control rooms with important vibration sensitive industrial facilities and servers Advantages: Do not require any commercial isolator. It is a part of regular construction. Additional cost involved is minimum Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Efficient Beam-To-Column Connection For Cold-Formed Steel Framing Value Proposition: Usage of cold-formed steel (CFS) sections as primary structural members in the construction of residential and industrial buildings has increased due to their advantages such as light weight, ease of handling, speed of erection and overall economy. Comprehensive design guidelines for the evaluation of strengths of CFS structural members are available in the literature and codes of practices. However, the guidelines for connection design are scanty and fail to accommodate the influence of connection behavior on the performance evaluation of frames. CFS buildings and frames are constructed by using stud-walls, which consist of closely spaced studs, track and wall boards, connected through self-drilling screws (SDS). These systems were reported to have poor performance under lateral loads. Based on the studies, it is inferred that the existing CFS framing systems result in poor seismic performance and the alternate framing systems were also reported to fail prematurely. Further, the seismic guidelines proposed for CFS framing systems are very minimal and the need for carrying out studies on CFS components under cyclic loading towards evaluating their seismic performance. The present technology is aimed to develop a CFS framing system, which would solve the above issues and thereby CFS framing systems can be classified as a ductile framing system. Summary Application: This technology has huge potential to use in Construction of residential buildings in the moderate seismic zones Adaptation of the mass-housing scheme as a prefabricated system. Augmentation of the lateral load resistance of the masonry systems. Advantages: Ductile CFS framing system Potential to use them in moderate seismic zones Easy to assemble the framing system Less construction time Feasibility for prefabricated construction Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Ethylene Scavenger Value Proposition: Ethylene scavengers offer a powerful solution for extending the shelf life and preserving the quality of fresh produce during storage and transportation. By absorbing or neutralizing ethylene gas—a natural plant hormone that accelerates ripening—these agents help delay spoilage, reduce waste, and maintain firmness, color, and nutritional value in fruits and vegetables. Ideal for use in packaging, cold storage, and shipping, ethylene scavengers enhance supply chain efficiency and profitability for producers, retailers, and exporters. Their non-toxic, food-safe formulations ensure safety and compliance, while supporting sustainability by minimizing food loss and promoting longer-lasting freshness from farm to consumer. Summary Application: Ethylene scavengers are widely used in the post-harvest handling of fruits and vegetables to extend shelf life and maintain freshness. They are integrated into packaging materials, storage rooms, and transport containers to actively absorb or neutralize ethylene gas emitted by produce. Commonly applied in cold storage facilities, shipping crates, and retail displays, these scavengers help reduce over-ripening, spoilage, and waste. They are suitable for a variety of ethylene-sensitive crops like bananas, tomatoes, avocados, and berries. By controlling ethylene levels, these scavengers support longer distribution chains, improve product quality, and enhance customer satisfaction in fresh produce supply chains. Advantages: Ethylene scavengers effectively extend produce shelf life by slowing ripening and spoilage. They reduce food waste, maintain quality, and preserve nutritional value. Easy to incorporate in packaging or storage, they are non-toxic and safe. This technology improves supply chain efficiency and enhances consumer satisfaction with fresher products. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Even Solar Sharing Agrivoltaics Value Proposition: Agrivoltaics (AV) is an innovative approach that combines agricultural production with photovoltaic power generation on the same land, aligning with India's goal to double farmers' income. CSIR-NIIST has developed the Even Solar Sharing (ESS) AV technology, currently at TRL 5, which offers solutions for shade-intolerant plants and features tunable ray spreading and spectral conversion. The ESS-AV system provides precision solar radiation control, reducing evapotranspiration and thermal stress on crops while increasing electricity generation through expanded PV coverage. Its versatility allows for converting existing PV plants into AV plants,plants, integrating PV with greenhouses, and implementing Building Integrated Agrivoltaics (BIAV) as a multifunctional roofing solution. With a market potential of 3,156 GW agrivoltaics installation in India alone, ESS-AV technology contributes to precision carbon-neutral farming and aligns with multiple Sustainable Development Goals and national initiatives. Summary Application: Agrivoltaics (AV) integrates agricultural production with photovoltaic (PV) power generation on the same land, supporting India's goal to double farmers' income. CSIR-NIIST's Even Solar Sharing (ESS) AV technology, at TRL 5, is designed for shade-intolerant crops and features tunable ray spreading and spectral conversion for precision solar radiation control. The system reduces evapotranspiration and thermal stress on crops while increasing electricity generation through expanded PV coverage. Its versatility enables retrofitting existing PV plants into AV systems, integrating PV with greenhouses, and implementing Building Integrated Agrivoltaics (BIAV) for multifunctional roofing. With a market potential of 3,156 GW in India, ESS-AV supports precision carbon-neutral farming and aligns with Sustainable Development Goals and national initiatives. Advantages: Dual-Use Technology: Enables simultaneous crop production and solar energy generation on the same land, optimizing land utilization Adaptive Light Management: Provides tunable ray spreading and spectral conversion for optimal crop-specific light conditions and increased energy yield. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Evergreen Hybrid Composites of Parali (Agro Wastes) and Industrial Wastes Value Proposition: CSIR-Advanced Materials and Processes Research Institute (CSIR-AMPRI), Bhopal has developed a technology for making Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood, using Parali (agro waste) and industrial waste particulates / fibres. This technology was developed with multiple objectives for multifunctional application as well as in view of effective use of Parali (agro wastes) and industrial wastes such ash marble wastes and fly ash. The findings of the research paves ways to introduce new materials to the society contributing to the National Forest Policy of Ministry of Environment and Forest (MoEF), Government of India for development of wood substitute for building application so that consumption of timber in building and house construction can be minimised. Furthermore, this will be a potential solution for effective utilisation of different agro-industrial wastes such as paddy straw, wheat straw, marble wastes, red mud, fly ash and other mineral, metallurgical wastes leading to solves various environmental threats associated with management of agro industrial wastes, deforestation and ecological imbalance. For making Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood, agro wastes primarily Parali (paddy straw/ stubble) and wheat straw, and industrial wastes, mainly marble wastes, fly ash from Thermal power plants, red mud from Aluminium industries were used as a primary raw material with natural fibres in polymeric system (Polyester / epoxy resin). The approach and concept for making this Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood is unique and have not yet been developed universally for practical commercial utility both in developed and developing countries. Summary Application: CSIR-Advanced Materials and Processes Research Institute (CSIR-AMPRI), Bhopal has developed a technology for making Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood, using Parali (agro waste) and industrial waste particulates / fibres. This technology was developed with multiple objectives for multifunctional application as well as in view of effective use of Parali (agro wastes) and industrial wastes such ash marble wastes and fly ash. The findings of the research paves ways to introduce new materials to the society contributing to the National Forest Policy of Ministry of Environment and Forest (MoEF), Government of India for development of wood substitute for building application so that consumption of timber in building and house construction can be minimised. Furthermore, this will be a potential solution for effective utilisation of different agro-industrial wastes such as paddy straw, wheat straw, marble wastes, red mud, fly ash and other mineral, metallurgical wastes leading to solves various environmental threats associated with management of agro industrial wastes, deforestation and ecological imbalance. For making Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood, agro wastes primarily Parali (paddy straw/ stubble) and wheat straw, and industrial wastes, mainly marble wastes, fly ash from Thermal power plants, red mud from Aluminium industries were used as a primary raw material with natural fibres in polymeric system (Polyester / epoxy resin). The approach and concept for making this Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood is unique and have not yet been developed universally for practical commercial utility both in developed and developing countries. Two international patents have been recently granted each in Eighty Countries on this technology. The performance of Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood would vary depending on the raw materials quantity, quality, particulate- fibre ratio, particulate / fibres – binder ratio, type of polymeric system and processing and manufacturing conditions. Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood can be made in single stage fabrication process as solid material as well as two stage process as sandwich composite of required performance. The demonstrated results revealed that high quality and glossy finish composites under single stage operating condition can be achieved using about 60% agro-industrial wastes. The innovative composite materials have variety of application potential for infrastructure in construction sector, locomotive (train) and other transport system (Bus, ship etc.) and infrastructure as doors, false ceilings, flooring, architectural wall panels, partition and furniture etc. The Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood is stronger, environmental friendly. Addition of agro-industrial wastes particulates and fibres enhances the surface finish, density, flexural modulus and resistance to abrasion. The Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood are durable, resistance to weather, corrosion, water, moisture and is termite, and fungus free composites. The composite materials are fire retardant, self-extinguishing nature, cost effective and maintenance free materials. Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood has potential to use as an alternate material for wood / timber, plastic, synthetic wood such as MDF Board, particle board and ply wood and all other conventional materials used in furniture industry. The technology is ready for commercialisation. A technology document has been prepared which would be delivered to the licensee. This technology document describes about the process know how for manufacturing Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood, which includes the details / specifications of raw materials such as (i) different agro-industrials wastes, fibres, particulates and polymeric system (ii) casting, fabrication of composites and curing (iii) performance of Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood, (iv) requirement of primary equipment and machineries for manufacturing of Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood in commercial scale. This technology would provide holistic solution to stop Parali burning and contribute for Atmanirbhar Bharat in creatingemployment and income and improving the livelihood of farmers and rural people in the state of Haryana and Punjab, where huge quantity of Parali has been burned which creates major smog and air pollution to the National Capital Delhi and NCR. This technology is one of the country most wanted innovation at this juncture as a game changer technology to provide multidisciplinary solutions to address multiple problems and contributing to National Program on Make in India, Skill and Clean India Mission program leading to job creation and environmental safety. For this technology two International Patents namely (i) A glossy finish sandwich composite and process for preparing the same (Grant No. 201811047389 , WO 2020/121319 A1, 18 June, 2020) and (ii) High performance glossy finish green hybrid composites with variable density and an improved process for making thereof (Publication No: 201811016873. WO2019/211862A1)have been filed and granted. In pursuance of the license agreement with M/s. Shubh Green Sheet Pvt Ltd, Bhilai, CG, on the Primary know-howto Mr. Arun Kumar Sahu and his collegium partner Mr. Ashok Kumar Verma, training and satisfactory demonstration for manufacturing Evergreen Hybrid Composites of Parali (Agro Wastes) and Industrial Wastes (Evergreen Hybrid Ply and Composite Wood) have been given to seven of his officials at CSIR AMPRI Bhopal during 16-21 October 2020 and the officials / trainees are fully satisfied with the working of the process and the know-how given to them. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Fabrication of All Vanadium Redox Flow Battery (AVRFB) Stack - 0.5 kW Value Proposition: At present, Redox Flow Batteries (RFBs) are very useful for integrating renewable energy into the grid by enabling long-duration, scalable, and sustainable energy storage systems. The energy density is predominantly dependent on the concentration (M) or volume of the electrolyte(L), whereas power density is determined by area (cm2) or number of cells. This key feature in RFBs enables the power ranging from kW to MW level and its energy can range from kWh to MWh. Hence, RFBs are widely recognized as a potential option for storing bulk electricity, especially from solar and wind. The individual cell components of redox flow batteries (RFBs) stacks are Aluminum end plates, graphite bipolar plates, graphite felts, copper current collector, gasket and membrane. During the course of know-how transfer All Vanadium Redox Flow Battery (AVRFB) Stack of 0.5 kW will be fabricated and demonstrated. Summary Application: Electrochemical energy storage, stationary applications to cover peak loads & load balancing, grid energy storage, uninterrupted power supply, and long duration. Advantages: The RFB offers a unique advantage of decoupling energy and power in contrast to conventional battery systems (Li-ion and lead acid batteries). The energy density can be tuned by varying the concentration (M) or volume of the electrolyte (L), whereas power density depends upon the active area (cm2) or number of cells in the stack. Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Flexi Heat Module Value Proposition: The flexible heating module is designed to heat steel beams, columns, and beam-to-column joints of any size and dimension in a controlled manner by operating across three independent zones. Each zone supports up to three thermocouples for precise temperature measurement. The temperature data is transmitted to a feedback-based control system, which adjusts heating output based on the set point and real-time temperature feedback. A host PC, equipped with custom-designed application software, provides an intuitive user interface for control, data recording, and analysis. This module accommodates heaters with power capacities ranging from 1.0 kW to 10 kW and is fully scalable to meet diverse requirements. By utilizing this module, the size limitations of specimens tested in conventional furnaces can be effectively overcome. Summary Application: Structural Integrity Testing: Heating steel components under controlled conditions to study their behaviour. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Floating Platform for Hybrid Offshore Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine (HAWT) and Solar Farm Value Proposition: This Floating Platform seamlessly integrates Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine (HAWT) with solar photovoltaic (PV) arrays on a single floating structure, delivering continuous, high-yield renewable energy generation even in deep water environments. It maximizes energy output per ocean footprint, reduces infrastructure and maintenance costs, and ensures energy stability through complementary wind–solar resource utilization. By combining proven offshore wind energy with solar energy harvesting, the platform offers: Higher capacity factor through dual source generation. Reduced levelized cost of energy (LCOE) via shared mooring, electrical infrastructure, and maintenance systems. Scalability and adaptability for various marine environments and energy demands. Sustainable energy production with minimal environmental footprint compared to traditional offshore installations. Summary Application: This floating platform integrates horizontal axis wind turbine (HAWT) with floating solar photovoltaic (PV) systems on a single structure to harness both wind and solar energy in marine environments. This hybrid approach is particularly suitable for deep water regions where fixed bottom turbines are impractical. It provides a stable, continuous renewable energy supply by combining the complementary generation profiles of wind and solar resources. Such systems can be applied for large scale offshore renewable power generation, grid connected energy supply, or as independent power sources for offshore industries such as aquaculture, hydrogen production, and desalination. By utilizing shared infrastructure and minimizing seabed disturbance, the hybrid floating platform optimizes ocean space use, reduces overall costs, and supports sustainable energy development in coastal and island regions. Advantages: Higher and more stable power output: Wind and solar complement each other, reducing intermittency and increasing total energy yield. Shared infrastructure: Common mooring, cabling, and maintenance systems lower overall costs. Efficient ocean space use: Combines two renewables on one platform, minimizing marine footprint. Improved cooling and performance: Ocean environment help to cool solar panels, enhancing efficiency. Reduced transmission losses: More consistent generation enables better grid utilization. Lower environmental and visual impact: Offshore installation avoids land use conflicts and reduces visibility from shore. Supports hybrid innovations: Enables integration with energy storage or hydrogen production for steady supply. Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Fly ash and Limestone Calcined Clay-based Mixtures for Concrete 3D Printing Value Proposition: This technology offers a sustainable, cost-effective, and high-performance material system for 3D concrete printing by partially replacing cement (15–25%) with a synergistic blend of limestone powder, calcined clay, fly ash, and silica fume. It significantly reduces CO₂ emissions (up to 30–40%) and material cost while maintaining excellent printability, mechanical strength, and durability. The solution addresses a key industry challenge — reducing the carbon footprint of 3D printable concretes without sacrificing performance or scalability. Summary Application: On-site printing of load-bearing walls, slabs, and structural components. Rapid-deployment shelters for disaster relief, defence, and low-cost housing. Repair and retrofit overlays using 3D-printed layers for enhanced performance. Applicable to automated and robotic construction platforms. Advantages: Compressive strength (40 MPa) suitable for structural-grade components. Enables support-less printing of complex geometries. Excellent extrudability, pumpability, buildability, and shape retention. Compatible with robotic and gantry-based 3D printing systems. Tech. FOBOP: Fibre Optic Based Break Out Prediction technology for Billet Caster 				
                        
					
                        	The present technology offers a real-time, temperature sensing system for monitoring the cold face temperature of a billet mold along its length and to predict breakout in a live billet caster well

full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: FOBOP: Fibre Optic Based Break Out Prediction technology for Billet Caster Value Proposition: During “Continuous Casting” in a steel plant, liquid steel is solidified into long solid bars with rectangular cross-sections (billets) during its passage through a water-cooled copper mold. The quality of the solidified billet is dictated by the manner in which heat is extracted from liquid steel in the copper molds. Along with the quality of the billets, “breakout” is another issue in the caster. A breakout is a liquid steel containment failure in which the solidifying shell of a continuously cast strand ruptures allowing the liquid steel within to ‘break out’. Breakouts are a major contributor to loss of productivity and equipment life at a continuous caster. Breakouts often lead to long outages which may involve laborious equipment cleaning with lancing and gas cutting and/or change of mold assembly/segments altogether. At billet casters, breakouts by themselves usually need a change of mold (20 to 30 mins) to restart, but they do cause significant production loss as the mold can only be changed when all strands are stopped and the tundish removed. Thus, in effect, a breakout could cause one strand to be unavailable for casting for an entire tundish sequence. Due to the size and shape restriction of the billet mold, it has not been possible to install temperature sensors to measure the temperature on a commercial billet caster. Thus, the assessment of the quality of the billet, as well as the breakout detection in the billet caster, remained an unmet need. Summary Application: The present technology offers a real-time, temperature sensing system for monitoring the cold face temperature of a billet mold along its length and to predict breakout in a live billet caster well in advance. This technology uses Fibre Bragg Grating (FBG) as a temperature sensor. Multiple sensors were written on a single optical fiber and embedded along the length of a billet mold. The “interrogation” of these sensors allowed for temperatures to be obtained along the length of the mold from a single strand of the optical fiber. In addition to the development of the packaged FBG sensor array, its installation in the harsh conditions (high temperature, high pressure, restricted space) of an operating caster has called for considerable engineering ingenuity. This too has been successfully accomplished. Technology has already been implemented at one of the casters in the renowned steel industry and break out has been successfully detected in one strand in a live caster. 1. Strand of an array of FBG sensors in a fiber 2. Proper encapsulation of fiber with an array of FBGs 3. Installation of encapsulated fiber on the machined Cu- mold 4. Test of output signals from the sensors on fixing of the mold in the caster. 5. Software for analyzing data to detect breakout and creating alarm prior to the breakout. Advantages: This technology can detect Break out in a billet caster well in advance. Hence a preventive action can be taken to avoid break-out to happen. This technology will help to avoid long outages which involve laborious equipment cleaning with lancing and gas cutting and/or change of mold assembly/segments altogether. Moreover, the overall advantage of this technology is avoiding loss of productivity and equipment life at a continuous billet caster worldwide. Commercialization Status: Already Commercialised Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Functionally Enhanced Foam Concrete for Structural and Non-Structural Applications Value Proposition: Foamed concrete (FC) containing porous microstructure produced by introducing pre-formed foam into the cement or mortar paste has several applications ranging from structural to non-structural applications due to its low density, self-levelling ability, low cost, low thermal conductivity, and fire-resistant properties. Properties of foaming agents and that prefabricated foams (stability, distribution, size, etc.) have become much more important concerns for foamed concrete. It is observed that foamed slurry collapse might be frequently occurred due to the deterioration of prefabricated foams in cement pastes before hardening. Hence, more stable prefabricated foams without bubble growth and bleeding are required to be encapsulated and maintained in fresh and hardened cement pastes in the formation process of foamed concrete. It is found that the addition of nano particles could increase the rigidity of the interfaces and decrease the foams permeability. Nano silica, Nano clay, Nano alumina and carbon nanostructures such as graphene, fullerenes and carbon nanotubes (CNTs), etc are some of the commonly used Nano additives. Several challenges will need to be solved to realize its full potential, including the proper dispersion of the nanoscale additives, scale-up of laboratory results and implementation on larger scale, and a lowering of the cost benefit ratio. Summary Application: Used as construction materials for tunnels and underground works to fill voids, sink holes, disused sewage pipes. Precast light weight foam concrete blocks/panels can be used in structural and non-structural applicationsfor load reduction in buildings. Foam concrete can be used as thermal insulation in the roofs to reduce the heat losses through building envelope layers and therefore reduce the energy consumption in the life cycle of modern civil buildings Advantages: Prefabricated foams through foaming agents with nanoparticles improves the properties of foaming agents and that prefabricated foams, further the mechanical properties and the microstructure characteristics of foam concrete. FC has been quickly promoted as construction materials for tunnels and underground works. Its excellent self-flowing capacity can be used to fill voids, sink holes, disused sewage pipes and so on. The low and controlled self-weight makes it capable for load reduction in buildings Precast light weight foam concrete blocks/panels can be used for structural and non-structural applications Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Geopolymer Foam Concrete (GeFoCON) Technology Value Proposition: Search for materials offering high thermal insulation has become a target of the modern construction and building industries. Foam concrete has relatively low thermal conductivity than normal dense concrete, usually 10–50% depending on the designed material density and composition. The low thermal conductivity brings good thermal insulation as well as energy efficiency in operation. Recent developments in alternative binders, have led to the manufacture of foam concrete using geopolymer as the binder. One of the most potential benefits of geopolymer is the reduced energy consumption and less CO2 emissions compared to ordinary Portland cement. The innovation of ambient temperature cured GeFoCON creates an approach of developing energy-efficient materials from material manufacturing to building operation, which seems to offer the possibility to be eco-friendly across the whole life cycle. Summary Application: GeFoCON can be used for producing construction blocks, panels for partitions in buildings, thermal and acoustic insulation of roofs and production of collapsible blocks, as well as floors and basement. Advantages: Thermal comfort Energy efficiency Ambient temperature cured Early strength Faster production Low power consumption High strength to weight ratio Tech. The developed gluten free biscuit is also enhanced with protein and fibre contents contributed by the ingredients chosen being nutritional and gluten free. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Green Coffee Extract Value Proposition: The Green Coffee Extract is produced using advanced cold extraction and filtration technology to preserve the natural chlorogenic acids, antioxidants, and bioactive compounds found in unroasted coffee beans. The process begins with selecting high-quality green coffee beans, followed by a gentle water or solvent-based extraction to maintain nutrient integrity. The extract is then concentrated and filtered to remove impurities, ensuring purity and potency. This technology enhances the stability and bioavailability of active compounds, making it suitable for use in dietary supplements, functional foods, and beverages. Rich in antioxidants, it supports metabolism, weight management, and overall wellness. Summary Application: The Green Coffee Extract technology features advanced cold extraction and filtration methods that preserve the natural chlorogenic acids, antioxidants, and bioactive compounds without high-heat processing. It uses gentle solvent or water-based extraction to maintain nutrient integrity and enhance bioavailability. The process includes precise concentration and purification steps to ensure high potency and purity. It supports clean-label formulations, free from artificial additives. The technology also offers long shelf stability while retaining the extract’s natural flavor and health benefits. Ideal for use in dietary supplements, functional foods, and beverages, it promotes metabolism, weight management, and overall wellness. Advantages: The Green Coffee Extract technology has diverse applications in both industrial and societal contexts. Industrially, it is used in the food and beverage sector to create functional drinks, weight management supplements, and energy products due to its metabolism-boosting chlorogenic acids. It is also incorporated into cosmetics for its antioxidant and anti-aging properties. Societally, it promotes healthier lifestyles by offering a natural, plant-based alternative to traditional weight loss and energy products. Its antioxidant-rich profile supports heart health, blood sugar regulation, and overall wellness. The technology also fosters sustainable agriculture by utilizing eco-friendly, plant-based ingredients. Commercialization Status: Licensed awaiting commercialisation Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Herbal Nanoserum - for Skin Care Value Proposition: Nanoemulsion based skin-care product containing active herbal ingredients. Summary Application: It is well known that in the cosmaceutics market, the emulsion based products are being in use since long time, but due to the size of oil droplets in the emulsion, they have limited penetration ability in the sub-dermal skin layers. To overcome these shortcomings , institute developed a nanoemulsion based skin-care product containing active herbal ingredients. The nanoemulsion comprises of sandalwood oil, non-ionic surfactant and water. Advantages: It is having nanodroplets (50 -100nm), which have active ingradients of sandalwood oil. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Herbal Inhaler Formulation Value Proposition: The novel patented water-soluble steam inhalation drop contains a blend of active essential oils from Eucalyptus globulus, Ocimum sanctum and other medicinal plants that are recommended by AYUSH for their extensive antimicrobial, antitussive, antispasmodic, anti-allergic and anti-inflammatory property which are backed up by scientific proof for their sustained action. The product mimics the existing conventional steam inhalation liquids but are made water soluble through formulation techniques which significantly reduce the burning sensation to nose and eyes during steam inhalation therapy. The medicinal herb ingredients help to reduce respiratory symptoms; and water solubility allows them to be released slowly along with steam providing long term effects without irritation and preventing dose dumping. Summary Application: This novel, patented water-soluble steam inhalation drop is formulated with active essential oils from Eucalyptus globulus, Ocimum sanctum, and other medicinal plants recommended by AYUSH. It offers the following applications: Respiratory Health: Helps alleviate respiratory symptoms such as cough, congestion, and nasal irritation. Antimicrobial Protection: Provides extensive antimicrobial effects, reducing respiratory infections. Therapeutic Benefits: Acts as an antitussive, antispasmodic, anti-allergic, and anti-inflammatory remedy. Improved User Comfort: Reduces the burning sensation in the nose and eyes during steam inhalation therapy, enhancing the user experience. Sustained Action: The water-soluble formulation allows a slow, controlled release of medicinal properties, providing long-term therapeutic effects while preventing dose dumping. Advantages: • Controlled or slow release of active ingredients • Safe and effective steam inhalation therapy up to 30 minutes • The novel formulation can hold the active ingredients up to 72 hours, if kept open Commercialization Status: Licensed awaiting commercialisation Tech. The increasing presence of recalcitrant compounds in wastewaters results in poor functioning of bio-based STPs and ETPs, thereby posing great risks regarding the contamination of food sources and their potential impact on human health. A high-performance advanced oxidation process was developed for the treatment of such STP and ETP wastewaters through sound-scientific basis of innovation using experimental, analytical and modeling tools. The process can be used for removal of organics from wastewaters in STPs, ETPs and industries. The process also enables extended membrane life by facilitating robust ZLD operation Summary Application: The process is suitable for an existing plant (for pre- and post-treatment) by retrofitting and also for new plants as a standalone plug-and-play option. The existing plants may also use the standalone plug-and-play model for organic-lean wastewaters. Advantages: The technology can be used for the treatment of domestic wastewaters in STPs, ETPs and also for industrial wastewaters such as food industry wastewaters like sugar, dairy, distilleries and non-food industry wastewaters like pharmaceutical. The process know-how can be used as pre-treatment/ post-treatment/ standalone option to enhance biodegradability, remove colour and reduce chemical oxygen demand (COD) to < 50 mg/L and total microbial load (TML) < 100 CFU/ml. The costing can be customized as per requirement for pre- and post-treatment also, with bench-scale treatability studies Commercialization Status: Already Commercialised Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: High-yielding Clone & Bioprocess for Production of Soluble, Tag-free Recombinant CRM197 Carrier Protein at Gram Scale Value Proposition: CRM197 is a genetically detoxified mutant of Diphtheria toxin (DTx, ~58 kDa). It features a single amino acid substitution at position 52, changing glycine to glutamic acid (G52E). This mutation eliminates its toxicity while preserving the immune-stimulatory and antigenic properties as the parent molecule, DTx. CRM197 is an integral component of conjugate vaccines used for the mass vaccination of millions of peoples, worldwide. Conjugated polysaccharide vaccines that include CRM197 as the carrier protein have been approved, including MENVEO®, a tetravalent conjugate vaccine targeting serogroups A, C, W-135, and Y of Neisseria meningitidis to prevent invasive meningococcal diseases; MENJUGATE®, targeting serotype C of Neisseria meningitidis; PREVNAR-13, PNEUBEVAX-14, a pneumococcal 13-valent and 14—valent conjugate vaccine, respectively for prevention of infants against Streptococcus pneumoniae infections; TYPHIBEV for prevention of Salmonella Typhi; Vaxem-Hib® and HibTITER®, which targets Haemophilus influenza type B, Hib. However, Indigenous technology to produce high-yield protein is not available in the country. We have developed a high yielding clone and scalable bioprocess for the production of soluble rCRM197 in E.coli. Summary Application: CRM197 is a genetically detoxified mutant of Diphtheria toxin (DTx, ~58 kDa) possessing mild endonuclease enzymatic activities. Protein's enzymatic activity is an inherent property of this protein and is considered a hallmark of protein functional integrity. CRM197 is a very high value protein and is an integral part of conjugate vaccines. The worldwide CRM197 manufacturing capability falls behind the market demands. Therefore, many research groups have been developing new protocols for high-yield CRM197 expression in different host organisms during the last two decades. The demand for CRM197 is high and at a retail price of about $~500-5000 USD per milligram, depending on the category of the molecule (R&D or GMP grade). CRM197 is conventionally produced from its native host Corynebacterium diphtheriae C7 strain, but suffers from low yield (10-50 mg/L) and requires a sophisticated contained bioprocess BSL-2 facility for large-scale fermentation. Therefore, high-yield recombinant production processes of CRM197 are the unfilled gap in the domain. A bioprocess for large-scale, high-yield, and affordable production of protein is urgently required to meet the increasing global demand. Advantages: High yielding clones producing ~1- 1.5 g protein per litre @ 10L bioreactor) Soluble expression of rCRM197. Industry compatible clone and bioprocess Tag-free clone design, suitable for Biopharma & vaccine application. Easy, high-efficiency single-step purification process. High-density fermentation process. Tech. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: HMIGauge 1.0: A Portable Image Colorimeter for Heavy Metals Detection in Water Value Proposition: Colorimetric field test kits are widely used in water quality analysis for low resource settings including rural area. However, the test results are analysed by comparing the color with a color comparison chart, which is a subjective method of quantification. Also, the result obtained is not recorded in real time. To overcome this issue, CSIO has developed a portable device that can be used in the field to quantify the color response of test strips, and a handy USB-shaped image colorimeter. The device can be used with any existing commercial test strips for colour-based water testing, and is currently ready for use for lead and residual chlorine quantification in water. Under ongoing project, device is being extended to cover more than 20 water quality parameters based on color change. In this line, CSIO has also developed a simple colorimetric kit is developed for the onsite detection of selenium. Selenium is a major water pollutant of concern over a few years in Indian states including Punjab and Haryana. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: Holistic Recycling of Red Mud for Recovery of Alumina, Iron, Rare Earth oxides, Titania with Utilization of Final Residue Value Proposition: >85-99% recovery of Alumina, Iron, Rare earth oxides (REOs) and Titania from red mud. For generic value, an estimate of 100kg of red mud upon processing by this technology generates 10.5 kg Alumina, 35.8 kg pig iron, 42 gram of REOs, 2.15kg TiO2 and 16.7kg geo-polymeric products . Summary Application: The red mud was processed by alkali roasting-water leaching to extract alumina (75-82%) and the residue was smelted to recover pig iron (95% recovery with 98% Grade). The remaining slag was processed in two stages to recover REEs and Ti in solution. The resultant PLS were processed individually by sequential precipitation to generate REOs (90.34%) and TiO2 (89.34%). The final residue generated was geo-polymerised to obtain products with 18-20 MPa compressive strength. The process developed on lab scale were tested at 10-200kg scale. Salient Technical Features: 75-82% alumina recovery in liquor 95% recovery of iron (>98% grade) 55-65% and 72-80% enrichment of REEs and titania in slag. Two-stage process for recovery of REEs and Ti 95% REEs extraction (99% Sc, 92% Ce, La and 88-90% Nd, Y). >90.34% pure REOs (10.6% La, 18.73% Ce, 4.15% Sc, 2.3% Nd, 1.07% Y, 0.04% Pr, 0.047% Ti and 0.67% total of Ca, Al, Fe) with 94.48% recovery. 86% Ti extracted in solution >89.53% TiO2 product (54.2% Ti, 13.52% Ca, 0.032% Al, 0.014% Fe, 3.774% S, 0.042% Si and 0.2% Na). 18-20 MPa geo-polymers from final residue 79 kWh energy consumption for 100kg Al, Fe, REE and Ti feed suitable for industrial applications Advantages: Technology can extract critical elements like La, Ce, Sc, Nd, Y and Ti as salts in most desired marketable form, with holistic recycling of Fe, Al, and can be generically applied to any composition of red mud. full_content: document.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault()); Technology Profile Title: HyThermSim: Thermo-mechanical Hybrid Simulation Platform for Structural Testing Value Proposition: This technology offers a realistic, cost-effective platform for evaluating thermo-mechanical behaviour of structures under complex conditions. It accurately simulates temperature-dependent dynamic responses, replicates boundary conditions with high fidelity and quantifies thermo-mechanical coupling, enabling better understanding of fire and seismic effects. Providing reliable data for model validation and flexible integration with simulations, it accelerates the development of safer structural systems across engineering domains. Summary Application: The hybrid thermo-mechanical testing platform is applicable across a wide range of structural and materials research domains. It enables evaluation of steel and concrete members under fire or high-temperature conditions, investigation of temperature-dependent behaviour in seismic isolation bearings and validation of thermo-mechanical constitutive models. The system also supports seismic simulations influenced by temperature effects, laboratory-scale testing coupled with full-structure models and the development of advanced hybrid control algorithms for dynamic structural analysis under thermal loading. Advantages: Enables real-time study of temperature effects on stiffness, damping and hysteresis under realistic loading. Supports diverse experimental setups with customizable virtual and physical models. Ensures accurate interaction replication through advanced impedance matching control. Summary Application: The technology comprises four components, each comprised of immobilized bacteria in nano-porous carbon/ iron doped nanoporous carbon/ enzyme immobilized nanoporous carbon. Advantages: Low Footprint requirement; No odour emission; Minimum sludge production compared to conventional technology; The technology can be integrated with membrane separation Tech.
